text:
rami: FYI - Support reported a mobile app case: truncated streaming response + immediate reconnect resulted in duplicate external tool enrichment calls and two ledger charges.
celine: rough repro?
rami: 1) client on mobile starts stream, receives a FIN at ~640 tokens (network hiccup + server-side truncation), 2) client retries right away, 3) router routes retry to regional standby shard (different shard), 4) toolcall fired again. Ledger shows provisional then confirmed both present.
harry: is session id preserved? our dedupe key is session + tool-hash.
rami: app left X-Session intact but headers changed (carrier NAT), router affinity changed because we prefer local-region by IP. dedupe cache is shard-local -> miss.
billing-bot: INFO billing: provisional_charge(session=mob-92,id=pc_z3,tokens=642)
billing-bot: INFO billing: confirmed_charge(session=mob-92,id=cc_q9,tokens=639)
celine: UI shows two separate rows, no refund flag. user understandably upset.
ops: immediate mitigations: mark provisional rows as "pending reconciliation" in ledger UI and add a single-click "Start refund review" button that auto-attaches traces.
devex: UI mock: tiny gray pill "pending" + hover text "may be de-duplicated after ledger reconciliation" and a link to open refund ticket prefilled with session + trace.
harry: longer term: three options we debated before: 1) global dedupe index (sync) 2) sticky-route on reconnect within a short window 3) client-sent idempotency token/dedupe-id.
rami: new wrinkle: mobile clients sometimes can't generate server-signed dedupe ids reliably if offline. plus we don't trust client input blindly.
celine: what about hybrid: when router sees a reconnect it adds X-Prev-Shard and X-Client-Dedupe if present. receiving shard will check local dedupe cache using (session, tool-hash) and, if miss, best-effort RPC to prev shard with a tight deadline (30-50ms). if prev responds DUP, skip toolcall. if probe times out, proceed.
harry: agree. keep RPC best-effort to avoid P99 regression. also compute server-side dedupe-id as HMAC(session||payload, shard-salt) and log it so ledger can later match provisional -> confirmed even if bucket changed.
billing-bot: NOTE billing: provisional entries can accept optional dedupe_id field for matching on reconciliation.
ops: requirement: no blocking cross-shard calls on critical path; probe must be <=50ms and toggleable.
devex: add console telemetry: show "route-change-on-retry" in trace view so support can quickly see why dedupe missed.
rami: plan: 1) router emits X-Prev-Shard when it detects reconnects within 45s and passes through client dedupe token if present. 2) shard: quick local lookup; on miss, fire best-effort RPC to prev shard with 40ms deadline. 3) ledger: accept dedupe_id on provisional writes; reconcile by dedupe_id when present. 4) console: provisional pill + refund shortcut + trace flag.
celine: tests: e2e sim that intentionally truncates stream FIN and retries to different shard; assert single toolcall after change. add unit tests for probe timeout behavior.
harry: metric: provisional_vs_confirmed_delta by shard and by route-change; alert if delta > 0.5% for 24h.
billing-bot: ACTION billing: expose reconciliation webhook so console can auto-update provisional rows when ledger finalizes.
ops: rollouts: canary 5% reconnects for 24h, monitor P99 and delta metric.
devex: I'll draft the UI copy and refund flow.
rami: filing INF-9902 with traces and proposed changes, tagging billing, routing, ops, and support. marking P2.
celine: thanks. one more thought: maybe give mobile SDKs a recommended client-side dedupe_id recipe (optional) and a fallback TTL server-side to help. document in SDK docs.
devex: will add a short devdoc + support note. :ok_hand:
